title: METAIS finding
description: One finding: a problem a command detected, named by a registered code, with where it is and what to do next. A member that is absent has no value; no member is ever null or the empty string where it names something. $defs/summary is the summary object that accompanies a list of findings.

code.title: Code
code.description: The registered code, a dotted lowercase name whose first segment is its family.

message.title: Message
message.description: One plain-text sentence saying what is wrong. Its wording is not normative.

hint.title: Hint
hint.description: The next step, naming a value, an edit or a command. Its wording is not normative.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The kind of thing the finding is about.

name.title: Name
name.description: The input name, the output's id, or the entry path of a template, an asset or a reference, or the example's name.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the value or file the finding reports is.

schema.title: Schema keyword
schema.description: The schema keyword the value broke.

entry.title: Entry
entry.description: The package entry the keyword was written in, or the manifest schema's published name.

pointer.title: Pointer
pointer.description: The keyword's location within the entry, as an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer.

keyword_location.title: Keyword location
keyword_location.description: The evaluation path from the root schema through every $ref, in JSON Schema's keywordLocation form.

field.title: Field
field.description: The title and description of the field the finding is about, from its schema.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: The code's registered parameters, in the registry's order. A number is in canonical JSON number form.

via.title: Via
via.description: The conditionals and alternatives that made the rule apply, outermost first.

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: For an anyOf or oneOf none of whose branches matched, each branch and its findings, in branch order.

pointer.title: JSON Pointer
pointer.description: An RFC 6901 JSON Pointer in its JSON-string form; the root is the empty string.

scalar.title: Scalar
scalar.description: A number, a string or a boolean.

location.title: Location
location.description: A place: the origin of the value, and the file, argument, line, column and pointer where they are known. A related location also carries its note.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: The source the value or file came from.

file.title: File
file.description: The file's path relative to the root of its origin, slash-separated.

argument.title: Argument
argument.description: The 1-based ordinal of the command-line argument the value came from.

line.title: Line
line.description: The 1-based line of the first character of the span.

column.title: Column
column.description: The 1-based column of the first character of the span, in Unicode code points.

pointer.title: Pointer
pointer.description: The JSON Pointer into the value the schema validates.

note.title: Note
note.description: For a related location, a short fixed phrase from the registry.

via.title: Via entry
via.description: An anyOf or oneOf branch, or the then or else a condition selected.

schema_pointer.title: Schema pointer
schema_pointer.description: The applicator's location in its schema entry.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: The 0-based index of the branch, for anyOf and oneOf.

title.title: Title
title.description: The branch's title, when it has one.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: The if subschema, for then and else.

schema_pointer.title: Schema pointer
schema_pointer.description: The if subschema's location in its schema entry.

title.title: Title
title.description: The if subschema's title, when it has one.

alternative.title: Alternative
alternative.description: One branch of an anyOf or oneOf: its findings, sorted and de-duplicated within the branch, at most 16, and how many more there were.

title.title: Title
title.description: The branch's title, when it has one.

omitted.title: Omitted
omitted.description: How many more findings the branch had.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The exact totals of a report, after de-duplication, whether each finding is listed or not. errors, warnings, info and by_code count report.truncated when the report has one; listed and omitted are its params, and count the other findings.

by_code.title: By code
by_code.description: The number of findings of each code, keys in byte order.
